meta.note: descriptive statistics only; EPA and EP columns are nflfastR's, not ours

go_rates.scope: regular season; decisions are fourth downs labelled go, field_goal or punt

offense_gap.sample: third-down runs and passes and fourth-down go plays with 1-3 to go, 2011-2025, regular season and playoffs (2010 has no previous-season prior)
offense_gap.strength_definition: early-down EPA per play from this season's earlier games, plus 300 pseudo-plays at 0.5 x last season's value

noise.scope: regular season 2010-2025; expected rate is the league rate in the same season, down and distance

team_season_fourth_short.label: fourth and 1-3 go plays, by team-season

team_season_all_fourth_go.label: all fourth-down go plays, by team-season

team_2021_2025_all_fourth_go.label: all fourth-down go plays, by team, 2021-2025 pooled

break_even.ep_source: nflfastR `ep` column (not this project's model); first-half style, clock and score ignored

leakage_test.description: early-down EPA of all team-games at or after the cutoff is scrambled; the as-of strength for games up to and including the cutoff week must be unchanged
